question: Can the deterministic logical parity be removed from complete straight-separator flux while preserving exact gluing and producing overlapping sector-conditioned residual interface laws?
claim_boundary: This is a finite exact construction/obstruction test. Passing establishes a nontrivial aligned observable, not thermodynamic contraction, correctability, a threshold or a phase.

frozen_model.separator_anchors: every vertex of the declared separator column
frozen_model.independent_unit: complete exact binary-current state space; no sampling

candidate_matrix.minimal_odd_shift: For anchor s, e_s is the one-hot interface vector and bar_U_s=U-H e_s.
candidate_matrix.why_all_anchors: Every l1-minimal odd translation is covered, preventing post-result anchor selection.
candidate_matrix.exact_gluing_test: For sector h, substitute U=bar_U_s+h e_s in both regional factors and verify that summing bar_U_s reproduces the original Z_h exactly.
candidate_matrix.support_test: For every ambiguous Q, compare supp(bar_pi_0^Q) and supp(bar_pi_1^Q).
candidate_matrix.weighted_test: Compute aligned TV, aligned revealed Bayes risk, cancellation, and E[r(Q) bar_d_Q] exactly at each frozen p.
candidate_matrix.physical_transport_audit: Record that sector-specific interface reindexing is not by itself a feasible, weight-preserving binary-current bijection; a fixed geometric path is rejected if it changes Q or its weight distortion grows with path length.

acceptance.integrity: zero parity-normalization failures and exact reproduction of both sector weights for every Q, p and anchor
acceptance.nontriviality: at least one ambiguous Q has overlapping aligned supports and bar_d_Q<1
acceptance.promotion: promote only as an exact aligned observable if integrity and nontriviality pass; do not claim contraction unless its risk-weighted TV is bounded uniformly in L
acceptance.rejection: reject any interpretation as a physical sector-switching coupling if binary feasibility, Q preservation or action-weight control is absent

stop_rule: Stop after all L3/L4 anchors and p values are evaluated. Do not add L, p or alternate shifts in response to the result.
outcome: Exact reindexing and nontrivial support overlap pass; interpretation as a physical coupling is rejected because fixed-path transport fails Q preservation and lacks size-uniform action distortion. No uniform contraction is established.
